verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe official Entrust IDV mobile SDKs for iOS, Android and React Native as direct replacements for the Onfido Smart Capture SDKs, with Flutter announced. The integration flow is documented: SDK tokens from workflow runs initialize the SDKs, and there is a migration guide plus an llms.txt describing an API and SDK platform. Missing for 10: evidence of official backend/server-side client libraries, details on web SDK coverage, Flutter is not yet released, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
